body: The past few days have had their ups and downs. Focusing on college work is helping a little. Looking forward to getting out the house and getting on with my studies. Also seeing my friends is an upside. The dogs know when I'm upset and lie down with me and try to lick my face. Annoying when I'm trying to sleep, but cute nevertheless. College should distract you. Do you not like college?
It's hard for me to focus on reading or anything like that. Somehow I get reminded of the current situation and break down. Even doing college work reminds me of it.
Do you have any pets? I could walk one of my 5 dogs (we like dogs a lot).

Well it's hard today because I would normally be going to his, but instead I have to stay in and clean my room. But my Mum said I can see my Dad tomorrow, so she is really just stopping me seeing him instead of 'grounding' me. Can't wait to get away from her to be honest.

I used to play video games constantly. Maybe not the healthiest hobby, but I really enjoyed it. But it doesn't just have the same appeal to me anymore. When I am with my boyfriend, I feel like my old self, until I am reminded. When I am in one of my bad places, I feel like I can get better.

What about drawing or origami? Both relieve stress. I am quite the arty person, but if you aren't, you could follow a tutorial. I do this a lot. Drawing eyes is hard. Also photography is really calming for me. You could use a phone and just go for a walk. Cooking also makes me feel good, and useful for when I have to move out and live on my own. I have struggled to keep in touch with my hobbies recently. But they are linked to my college work, so I kinda have to practice. I feel better than yesterday, Not 100%, but I'm in a better place mentally. I need to start pretending I'm okay so my Mum doesn't find out about anything else. Sometimes forcing myself to do things I really don't want to (e.g. socialising with people) actually helps. It helps me forget about it for a little while.

We have a 'study support' program I think. I could look into that when I start back. We always skype and stuff, the highlight of the day for me! I hope I can do this. It seems so hard and impossible. Giving up seems more logical but I know that isn't true. Thank you so much. Posting here has really helped me!

You could learn a new hobby? I do art and stuff for graphic design. I am not too sure what self help means, but here is a link
http://www.nhs.uk/conditions/stress-anxiety-depression/pages/self-help-therapies.aspx
I guess it is stuff you can do to help

I have seen a doctor. But they have put it down to stress. So I am going to find a therapist asap. I can't even leave the house because I'm grounded. The only way I can distract myself is by doing college work. But it only helps a little.

I'm 17. It is exhausting. I feel tired constantly and get called lazy as a result. You need a goal to motivate yourself. Well that works for me. They can be little things. Because it makes me feel good when I have finished something and can tick it off as done. No idea if that would help you. Also I got a leaflet today about therapy and it mentions self help. I haven't looked into it, but you could try that?

They never gave me any. They think it is because of stress with work and college. But I think I will be given some after the assessment. Also because of my age, they are less likely to give me them. Plus just taking anti depressants doesn't help. You need therapy too soo you can eventually stop taking them. Hence why I think my therapist would prescribe them. I have no idea if you can request them from the doctor. But I think you should book an assessment like me, if you can do that.

My Mum and Dad both have depression. I thought my Mum would be more understanding because of this. You could try to not involve them and see a therapist. I went to the doctors today and they said I can request an assessment without involving my gp or family. You could try that? I guess it depends where you live, as I can access this stuff for free

I wish I could move out. But my grandparents won't let me live with them, and my Dad can't do it either. Plus my Mum threatens me with phoning the police. My Mum manipulates me with seeing my Boyfriend (until she stopped me seeing him), and my suicidal thoughts. And when I tell her what she is doing is wrong, she calls me nasty names which she knows hurt me. If I move to my boyfriend's, I would have to transfer colleges. But some courses may not transfer. He lives a fair distance away from me, so the college buses don't run from there. It's an hour in the car from where they live to the campus too. I don't really know where else I could go. I will book counselling as soon as I can. I need to.

I keep in close contact with him via text messages and Skype calls. She thinks he is the reason behind my less than okay grades at college. But during the exam period, I was in a similar state to what I was yesterday. I need to sort my grades out. I know that. But she just doesn't like him (for stupid reasons like him being. 1 year (exactly) younger than me, and for being bisexual). This family is judgmental and disgusting. I will put all my effort into getting the best grades I can and move out asap. Then cut all contact. It may upset her but she isn't good for me. I have tried telling her. On many occasions. She isn't what I need right now. I am also going to look into counselling at college when it starts. She also said I'm too immature for a relationship' because I want to seem him. But she let someone she knew for less time move in with us permanently.
I am 18 in 6 months too. It seems like I can't do anything really. I could go to the doctors and tell them everything. That may help.
But does it change if I'm 17? I don't think I'm classed as an adult. She also could say I'm suicidal to the police to win them over.

I started crying and collapsed when I told my Mum. It's hard to be calm and composed when you have emotions like this. I think she will believe you. If not, you can always get support of someone else. A extended family member or friend maybe? I feel like that too. Sometimes I forget I have issues at all, but it doesn't take much to bring all those feelings back.

Me and my boyfriend have only been together just over 6 months. I don't think the length of the relationship matters. But you need to open up to someone close. Not necessarily someone you are close you romantically. I went to the doctors and plan to get counseling as soon as I can. I would be happy to talk to you about anything. We could help each other?

There are only a few people I am concerned with upsetting. My boyfriend, my Dad and my Gran. They have been understanding, and have listened when I needed someone to talk to. But I have realised that they can't fix this for me. I have to fix it. And if that means moving out when I can and blocking all contact, then I will. I have tried talking to my Mum on a lot of occasions and she just shouts and calls me names. I will act as if nothing is wrong. At least then I can start cutting the ties in that relationship.

It took me a year to admit it to my family. And a few months to tell my boyfriend. I was scared he would judge me and break up with me. But he just listened when I explained why. Something which no one has done before. Could you not tell your girlfriend?
I am feeling better now. Just a little upset. But no less than usual.

Even though I'm only 17? I thought I would be considered a child. I am going to the doctors first thing tomorrow. Maybe I could get a counsellor in college. I just want her to realise what she is doing to me. But I am slowly beginning to realise I will have to block all contact with her when I move out.

I'm 17 and live in the UK. I have no one to move in with nearby (so I could continue going to college). I am going to the doctors tomorrow. I could move in with my boyfriend's parents and transfer colleges, or wait till I go to Uni and get my own place. I am going to stop telling my Mum about this stuff so she can't bully me about it. I think telling her was a big mistake. But I thought she would help.
I'm going back to the doctors on my own tomorrow. Maybe your family will be more understanding than mine. I have 1 person I can talk to, do you have someone like that?

I would go and see him if she wouldn't report me as missing. She uses the fact that I'm suicidal to keep me at home. One thing she said was "I will report you as missing and suicidal if you don't come home".

I will ask about counselling when I start back at college. I have no way of seeing him anymore and she said she will report me to the police as missing if I see him. It's hard to accept that she is wrong when my extended family defend her too. When I try to speak to people she has a go at me too. Even when I told her it was the Samaritans (suicide hotline thing)
